name: Report Line 7
definition: Information about a payment against a purchase order.

TransactionIdentification.name: Transaction Identification
TransactionIdentification.definition: Unique identification assigned by the matching application to the transaction.

PurchaseOrderReference.name: Purchase Order Reference
PurchaseOrderReference.definition: Unique identification of the purchase order, assigned by the buyer.

Adjustment.name: Adjustment
Adjustment.definition: Specifies the adjustments applied to obtain the net amount.

NetAmount.name: Net Amount
NetAmount.definition: Net amount, after adjustments, intended to be paid.
